I’m obsessed with the hard thing about hard things.

I started my career in investment banking, but over time, I realized I was more interested in building businesses than just understanding how they worked. That curiosity led me into tech, where I joined Okra, an open banking infrastructure startup, working across strategy, product, and partnerships. I really enjoyed being at the intersection of business and technology, and eventually decided to take the leap and co-found Barrel, an enterprise AI startup.

After a few years of building, I decided to pursue my MBA at Cornell University. More recently, I spent my summer at Amazon, getting to work on interesting problems at a completely different scale.

These days, I’m exploring what’s next, spending a lot of time experimenting with AI, building things that interest me, and seeing where my curiosity takes me.
